home.heroTitle3: Where the glow fades, look closer.
home.heroBody: Healthy lining of the mouth glows green under 405 nm violet light. Areas that lose the glow, together with what the health worker sees and the person's habits, are turned into a risk level with every reason shown — so the right people are referred for clinical examination.
home.sceneLabel: Animation: a violet light sweeps across tissue. Healthy tissue glows green; one patch stays dark.

how.captureBody: A white-light photo and a violet-light photo of each site, plus an optional probe reading.
how.analyseBody: Quality checks, WL/AF alignment and a glow map find where fluorescence fades.
how.triageBody: Transparent rules turn findings and risk factors into a risk level with reasons and a next step.

home.demoBody: Run the full pipeline on generated, clearly labelled synthetic captures. No real patient data.

low.title: Low-risk demo
low.body: Even green glow on both cheeks. No lesion seen by eye.

why.intro: Every point added or removed is listed. The rules are a transparent baseline heuristic, not a trained model.
why.noFactors: No suspicious features added points. Habits are used for counselling, not scoring, when no finding exists.
why.noScore: No score: the images could not be analysed reliably.
why.sumNote: Bars add up, left to right, to the total score.
why.chartLabel: Contribution of each factor to the score

qc.image_invalid: Photo could not be checked — retake the photo.
qc.image_too_small: Photo too small — retake at full camera resolution.
qc.image_grayscale: Photo has no colour — switch camera to colour, retake.
qc.blur: White-light photo blurry — hold the phone steady and retake.
qc.too_dark: White-light photo too dark — switch on the light, retake.
qc.too_bright: White-light photo too bright — move back slightly and retake.
qc.clipping_dark: Parts of photo too dark — light the whole area evenly.
qc.clipping_bright: Parts of photo washed out — reduce the light and retake.
qc.glare: Too much shine — tilt the phone slightly and retake.
qc.glare_minor: Some shine on tissue — tilt the phone slightly next time.
qc.af_signal_low: Violet-light photo too dim — switch on violet light, retake.
qc.af_filter_leak: Violet-light photo too blue — fit the yellow filter, retake.
qc.af_overexposed: Violet-light photo too bright — move back slightly, retake.
qc.af_blur: Violet-light photo blurry — hold the phone steady and retake.
qc.af_not_green: Violet-light photo not green — check filter and colour setting.
qc.ambient_light: Dark photo too bright — block room light and retake.
qc.ambient_light_minor: Some room light seen — dim lights or shade the mouth.
qc.no_dark_frame: Dark photo missing — take one with all lights off.
qc.misaligned: Photos do not line up — keep still between both photos.
qc.alignment_marginal: Photos line up poorly — keep steadier between photos.
qc.insufficient_mucosa: Too little tissue in view — open wider, move closer.
qc.spectral_no_readings: No probe readings — repeat the probe measurement.
qc.spectral_few_readings: Too few probe readings — repeat the probe measurement.
qc.spectral_channels_missing: Probe data incomplete — reconnect the probe, repeat.
qc.spectral_checks_skipped: Probe contact not checked — hold it flat on tissue.
qc.spectral_saturated: Probe signal too strong — lower probe gain and repeat.
qc.spectral_ambient_leak: Room light reaching probe — press it gently on tissue.
qc.probe_no_contact: Probe not touching tissue — place it flat and repeat.
qc.spectral_signal_low: Probe signal too weak — check probe light and repeat.
qc.spectral_poor_repeatability: Probe readings unsteady — hold the probe still, repeat.
qc.spectral_settings_mismatch: Probe settings changed mid-reading — repeat measurement.
